01政策与法规 · 2026年11月16日

美国琼斯法案豁免再延90天至2027年2月

US Extends Jones Act Waiver Into February

Washington has extended the Jones Act waiver for another 90 days, allowing foreign-flagged vessels to keep moving specified domestic cargoes between US ports until 14 February 2027. It is the third extension since the waiver was first granted in March, and the longest waiver in the century-old law's history. The voyage-by-voyage case-by-case approval system introduced in August remains in place, and the American Maritime Partnership has again criticised the waiver.

美国政府将《琼斯法案》豁免再延长90天，外国籍船舶可继续在美国港口之间运输指定国内货物至2027年2月14日。这是自3月首次豁免以来的第三次延期，也是该百年法律历史上最长的一次豁免。8月起实施的逐航次个案审批制度继续保留，美国海事伙伴组织再次批评该豁免。

补充数据（白宫 / Cato Institute 口径）：白宫称自3月豁免以来已有9,000万桶石油产品在美国港口间运输；Cato Institute 追踪显示截至11月10日外国船共完成343个航次。Extra data (White House / Cato Institute figures): the White House says 90m barrels of petroleum products have moved between US ports since the March waiver; Cato Institute tracking shows foreign ships had completed 343 voyages as of 10 November.

02政策与法规 · 2026年11月16日

印度放宽船舶注册规则，争取更多本国吨位

India Eases Flag Rules in Push for More Tonnage

India has relaxed its ship registration rules so vessels with more than 50% Indian ownership can qualify for the Indian flag, replacing the requirement for full qualifying Indian ownership and opening the door to foreign minority investment. The change was gazetted under the Merchant Shipping Act, 2025. New Delhi is also building the state-backed Bharat Container Shipping Line and promoting ship finance, insurance and domestic shipbuilding.

印度放宽船舶注册规则，印度籍所有权占比超过50%的船舶即可取得印度旗籍，不再要求全部为符合资格的印度所有权，为外国少数股权投资打开大门。新规依据《2025年商船法》刊登于印度政府公报。印度同时在建设国营 Bharat Container Shipping Line，并推动船舶融资、保险与造船。

03政策与法规 · 2026年11月16日

香港五年规划：海事重心从货量转向价值

Hong Kong's Five-Year Clock

Hong Kong is pushing to become a "global maritime capital", shifting focus from container throughput to high-value businesses such as ship finance, insurance, management and bunkering. The first five-year plan for 2026–2030 sets out the shift "from volume to value", targeting a 30% cut in Kwai Tsing terminal emissions by 2030 versus 2021, five green energy corridors, and 7% of Hong Kong-registered ships using green marine fuels. Hong Kong and Shanghai signed a "sister port" cooperation agreement on 20 October.

香港政府推动把香港打造成"全球海事之都"，重心从集装箱吞吐量转向船舶融资、保险、管理与加注等高价值业务。2026–2030年首个五年规划明确"由量转值"，目标包括到2030年葵涌码头碳排放较2021年降30%、建立五条绿色能源走廊、7%的香港注册船舶使用绿色海事燃料。10月20日香港与上海签署"姊妹港"合作协议。

补充数据：2025年香港集装箱港处理12.99m TEU（同比降5.1%），约为2008年峰值的一半；香港注册总吨截至今年6月降至109m gt；2026年新华–波罗的海国际航运中心排名第四。Extra data: Hong Kong handled 12.99m TEU in 2025 (down 5.1%), about half its 2008 peak; the Hong Kong register stood at 109m gt as of June; Hong Kong ranked fourth in the 2026 Xinhua–Baltic International Shipping Centre Development Index.

06安全与事故 · 2026年11月15日

伊朗称三艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷起火，超油轮沉没说法未经证实

Three Tankers Catch Fire After Hitting Mines in Hormuz

Iran's navy said three tankers caught fire on Saturday after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, one in the eastern strait and two later the same day. Iran said on Sunday that one of them, a supertanker said to be carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude, had sunk, but gave no vessel name or flag and Reuters said it could not independently verify the claim. Britain's UKMTO said it was aware of a tanker incident reported by Indian shipping authorities but could not confirm it was the same event.

伊朗海军称，三艘油轮周六在霍尔木兹海峡触及水雷后起火，其中一艘在海峡东部触雷、另两艘当日稍后触雷。伊朗方面周日又称其中一艘载有逾200万桶原油的超级油轮沉没，但未公布船名与船籍，Reuters 称无法独立核实。英国 UKMTO 称获悉印度航运当局报告的一起油轮遇袭事件，但无法确认是否为同一事件。

补充：霍尔木兹海峡正常承担约全球20%的石油液体运输。另见 Gulf News 对伊朗"超油轮沉没"说法的报道（未经证实）：Gulf News 补充链接 →。Note: Hormuz normally carries about 20% of global petroleum liquids. See also Gulf News on Iran's unverified sinking claim via the supplementary link.

04安全与事故 · 2026年11月15日

美国法院下令扣押新奥尔良撞船事故油轮

US Court Orders Arrest of Tanker After New Orleans Cruise Ship Collision

A US federal court has authorised the arrest of the 17,764 dwt asphalt tanker Atlantic Asphalt. The Board of Commissioners of the Port of New Orleans sued in the Eastern District of Louisiana seeking more than $1m in damages, alleging the tanker struck the berthed American river cruise ship American Heritage at the Thalia Street Terminal on 13 November, capsizing and partially sinking her and hospitalising 32 people, with no deaths. Defendants include owner Nave Shipping SA and Singapore-based Thome Ship Management.

美国联邦法院授权扣押17,764载重吨沥青油轮 Atlantic Asphalt。此前新奥尔良港务委员会在路易斯安那东区法院起诉，要求逾100万美元赔偿，指该轮11月13日撞上停靠于 Thalia Street 码头的美国内河邮轮 American Heritage，致其倾覆并部分沉没，32人送医、无人死亡。被告包括船东 Nave Shipping SA 与新加坡 Thome Ship Management。

NTSB：新奥尔良撞船油轮发生"舵机故障"

Tanker in New Orleans Ship Collision Suffered 'Steering Casualty,' NTSB Says

The US National Transportation Safety Board said on Sunday that the tanker that collided with a berthed luxury paddlewheeler in New Orleans had suffered a "steering casualty", though officials said the cause of the Atlantic Asphalt's steering failure was not yet clear. The vessel's voyage data recorder has been recovered; the NTSB expects a preliminary report within 30 days and a final report in 18–24 months.

美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）周日表示，与新奥尔良停靠的豪华明轮船相撞的油轮发生了"舵机故障"，但官员称尚不清楚 Atlantic Asphalt 号舵机失灵的原因。该轮的航行数据记录仪已被回收，NTSB 预计30天内发布初步报告，最终报告需18–24个月。

07安全与事故 · 2026年11月15日

三艘商船在罗马尼亚苏利纳运河附近黑海海域遭无人机袭击

Three Ships Struck by Drones in Black Sea Near Romanian Shipping Canal, PM Says

Romanian Prime Minister Luca Niculescu said on Sunday that three merchant ships were struck by drones in the Black Sea near the Sulina Canal, and Romania's armed forces scrambled fighter jets twice. The defence minister said there were no casualties and crews had brought onboard fires under control. The vessels hit were the Greek-flagged chemical tanker Evia Petrol V, the bulker Marsol and the product tanker Ali Najafov; a Palau-flagged general cargo ship, Larissa 1, was also hit by a drone on Friday night, again with no casualties. The Sulina Canal is a key waterway linking the Danube to the Black Sea.

罗马尼亚总理 Luca Niculescu 周日表示，三艘商船在黑海苏利纳运河附近遭无人机袭击，罗马尼亚武装部队两度紧急出动战斗机。国防部长称无人伤亡，船员已控制住船上火灾。被袭船舶为希腊旗油化船 Evia Petrol V、散货船 Marsol 与油品油轮 Ali Najafov。另有一艘帕劳旗杂货船 Larissa 1 于周五晚被无人机击中，同样无人伤亡。苏利纳运河是连接多瑙河与黑海的关键航道。

08港口与物流 · 2026年11月16日

霍尔木兹海峡受阻，阿拉伯海港口业务激增

Arabian Sea Ports Are Booming as the Conflict Drags On

With shipping through the Strait of Hormuz disrupted, logistics firms are rerouting via Arabian Sea ports. TEU flows from the UAE's east-coast ports of Fujairah, Khorfakkan and Dibba to the Jebel Ali inland distribution hub run at about 3,500 TEU a day, up 30% during the third quarter of 2026; DP World has moved more than 1m TEU from the east-coast ports to Jebel Ali since the war escalated. Oman's Duqm and Salalah ports are benefiting from spare capacity.

随着霍尔木兹海峡航运受阻，物流企业正绕开海湾改走阿拉伯海港口。阿联酋东海岸富查伊拉、豪尔费坎与迪巴港至杰贝阿里内陆分拨中心的 TEU 流量约达每天3,500 TEU，2026年第三季度内增长30%；自战争全面爆发以来，DP World 已从阿联酋东海岸港口向杰贝阿里转移逾100万 TEU。阿曼杜库姆港与萨拉拉港因有富余运力而受益。

补充数据：富查伊拉等泊约9天、集装箱离港另需15天；杜库姆10月底等泊平均3天；萨拉拉2026年上半年处理2.33m TEU（同比增15%）。Extra data: berthing waits at Fujairah run to about 9 days, with a further 15 days for containers to leave the port; Duqm averaged 3-day waits at end-October; Salalah handled 2.33m TEU in H1 2026 (up 15%).

09港口与物流 · 2026年11月15日

德班港集装箱延误接近20天

Durban Container Delays Approach 20 Days

South African automotive components maker Metair has warned that severe congestion at the Port of Durban is causing container delays approaching 20 days and threatening its ability to meet customer commitments. A Johannesburg Stock Exchange announcement said the new terminal operating system at Durban Gateway Terminal had severely disrupted container handling, compounded by equipment failures and too few available cranes. The terminal is operated by ICTSI under a 25-year partnership with Transnet. Metair estimates additional costs in 2026 of 20%–25% of its 2025 EBITDA before exceptional items, and says meaningful improvement may not come before the end of the first quarter of 2027.

南非汽车零部件制造商 Metair 警告，德班港严重拥堵导致集装箱延误接近20天，威胁其履行客户承诺。约翰内斯堡证交所公告称，德班 Gateway 码头新码头操作系统上线后严重扰乱集装箱作业，设备故障与可用岸桥不足加剧延误。该码头由 ICTSI 通过与 Transnet 的25年合作运营。Metair 估计2026年因此产生的额外成本为其2025年 EBITDA（特殊项目前）的20%–25%，有意义的改善或要到2027年第一季度末之后。

10港口与物流 · 2026年11月15日

瓦尔帕莱索港达成协议，获得五台岸桥

Valparaíso Secures Five Cranes in Terminal Concession Settlement

Chile's Empresa Portuaria Valparaíso (EPV) and Terminal Pacífico Sur (TPS) have reached an agreement settling a contractual dispute and securing the handover of five ship-to-shore cranes when the operator's concession ends in December 2029. Signed on Friday, the deal amends the Terminal 1 container concession, resolving disputes over priority access to the port's southern entrance, economic compensation and the valuation of past terminal investments. The parties agreed a residual investment value of $15.39m, to be paid by EPV to TPS at the end of the concession.

智利 Empresa Portuaria Valparaíso（EPV）与 Terminal Pacífico Sur（TPS）达成协议，解决合同纠纷，并确保在运营商特许权2029年12月到期时移交五台岸到船起重机。协议于周五签署，修订了1号集装箱码头特许权，解决了港口南入口优先通行权、经济补偿与既往码头投资估值等争议。双方商定残余投资价值1,539万美元，由 EPV 在特许期结束时支付给 TPS。

11港口与物流 · 2026年11月15日

洛杉矶港务局长对罢工威胁保持信心，港口创纪录

Los Angeles Port Chief Confident Amid Ongoing Strike Threat

Port of Los Angeles Executive Director Gene Seroka said he does not expect the strike threat to interrupt a record year for container business, even though the local International Longshore and Warehouse Union chapter's contract with the Pacific Maritime Association has expired and is under negotiation. The port handled 1.027m TEU in October, a fifth consecutive monthly record; the two sides agreed last week to further talks and extended the contract to 20 November. Through October the port has handled 9.1m TEU, about 5% more than in the same period of 2025.

洛杉矶港执行董事 Gene Seroka 表示，尽管当地国际码头与仓库工会（ILWU）分会与太平洋海事协会（PMA）的合同已到期并在谈判，他不认为罢工威胁会打断港口前所未有的集装箱业务年。洛杉矶港10月连续第五个月创纪录，处理102.7万 TEU；双方上周同意追加谈判并将合同延至11月20日。截至10月港口累计处理910万 TEU，较2025年同期高约5%。

12港口与物流 · 2026年11月15日

南加州港口进口持续激增，10月进口超100万TEU

Imported Goods Keep Surging Through Southern California Ports

Import containers through America's busiest trade gateway topped one million for a second time in October, with the ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach importing a combined 1,000,500 TEU, just below September's all-time high. Some firms are importing goods for AI build-outs while others are stocking up as tariff uncertainty drags on. Total loaded and empty volumes rose more than 20% year on year at Los Angeles and more than 11% at Long Beach, while exports fell 7% and 6% respectively.

美国最繁忙贸易枢纽的进口集装箱10月第二次突破100万大关，洛杉矶港与长滩港合计进口1,000,500 TEU，仅略低于9月历史最高。部分企业为 AI 建设进口货物，另一些企业则在关税不确定性延长之际提前备货。与去年10月相比，洛杉矶港装载进出口与空箱总量增逾20%，长滩港增逾11%；出口则分别下降7%与6%。

加拿大出资1.4亿美元扩建Woodfibre LNG出口终端

Canada Commits $140m to Woodfibre LNG Export Terminal Expansion

Canada's government has committed C$200m ($140m) to expand the Woodfibre LNG export terminal under construction near Squamish, British Columbia, raising planned annual capacity from 2.1m tonnes to 2.5–2.6m tonnes, an increase of up to 24%. The funds will improve reliability, efficiency and capacity and study a second phase. The project is about 75% complete and is expected to start up in late 2027.

加拿大政府承诺出资2亿加元（1.4亿美元），扩建位于不列颠哥伦比亚省斯阔米什附近在建的 Woodfibre LNG 出口终端，规划年产能从210万吨提升至250–260万吨，增幅最高24%。资金将用于提升终端可靠性、效率与产能，并研究二期可能性。该项目已完成约75%，预计2027年底投产。

分析称即使美伊达成和平协议，霍尔木兹LNG航运仍将受扰

Analysts Tell Montel Hormuz LNG Shipping Will Stay Disrupted After Any US-Iran Peace Deal

Analysts told Montel that even if the US and Iran reach a peace deal, LNG shipping through the Strait of Hormuz may not return to normal quickly, because owners' and insurers' assessment of safety risks — not diplomacy alone — will determine how fast services resume. Markets remain under pressure, with the Asian LNG benchmark JKM up 5.91%.

分析师向 Montel 表示，即使美伊达成和平协议，霍尔木兹海峡的 LNG 航运也可能难以迅速恢复正常，因为船东与保险商对安全风险的判断将决定复航速度，而非仅外交协议。市场仍承压，亚洲 LNG 基准 JKM 上涨5.91%。

希腊Naftomar重返韩国订造四艘LPG船

Naftomar Returns to South Korea for LPG Quartet

Greek gas carrier owner Naftomar has been linked to an order for four 9,000 cu m semi-refrigerated LPG carriers at HD Hyundai's medium-sized shipbuilding operation in South Korea, for delivery between December 2028 and September 2029, adding 36,000 cu m of capacity. No contract price has been reported and neither owner nor yard has publicly confirmed the order. The deal extends Naftomar's presence in the smaller gas carrier segment.

日本ONE集装箱船三年来首次穿越红海

Japan Shipping Group ONE Transits Red Sea Choke Point for 1st Time in 3 Years

A Europe-bound container ship of Japan's Ocean Network Express (ONE) has transited the Bab el-Mandeb Strait at the southern end of the Red Sea for the first time in three years. ONE suspended its Red Sea/Suez Asia–Europe services in December 2023 and said in October it planned to resume them. The Red Sea route saves 10–15 days versus sailing around the Cape of Good Hope, and ONE hopes the shorter transit will win back cargo; Drewry data show 53 Asia–Europe container ships transited the Suez Canal in the first week of November.

日本海洋网联船务（ONE）一艘欧洲方向集装箱船三年来首次穿越红海南端的曼德海峡。ONE 自2023年12月起暂停经红海/苏伊士运河的欧亚航线，10月表示计划恢复。经红海较绕行好望角可节省10–15天，ONE 希望以缩短的航程夺回货量。Drewry 数据显示11月第一周有53艘亚欧航线集装箱船通过苏伊士运河。
